moodys.citation_text: Moody's held CMC at Baa3 entering 2020. Outlook later revised to Negative in 2022 while affirming Baa3 — confirms Baa3 was the starting level.

sp.citation_text: S&P held CMC at BBB+ entering 2020. S&P lowered to BBB- in Sept 2023 (out-of-window); BBB+ was the prior held rating.

rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Moody's revised CMC outlook to negative; Baa3 affirmed. Operating weakness from labor costs and uncertain strategic direction (HCA discussions had not yet been made public).

outcome_class_rationale: CMC held Baa3 with Moody's outlook revised to negative within 2022. The 2023 multi-notch downgrades (Moody's to Ba1; S&P to BBB-) are OUT-OF-WINDOW. Within window, signal was clear deterioration but ratings held.

operating_metrics_fy2020.citation_text: CMC single-hospital ~$400M revenue, modest debt, decent liquidity as of FY2020. _warning: peer-typical estimates for Baa3 small-system; specific audited line items not directly retrieved.
